content:
Looking at the left half of the disk (the semicircle from B to A along the shaded side), the angles along the diameter must sum to 180°.

The marked angles are 40°, 30°, and 45°, so the central angle of the shaded sector is:
180° − 40° − 30° − 45° = 65°

The probability of landing in the shaded sector equals the ratio of its central angle to the full circle:
65° / 360° = 13/72

\boxed{13/72}
